arguments.sql:
WITH intelligence AS (
    SELECT s.id, s.superhero_name, ha.attribute_value, s.weight_kg
    FROM superhero AS s
    JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
    JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
    WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
)
SELECT attribute_value, typeof(weight_kg) AS storage_type, COUNT(*) AS records,
       COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS heroes, MIN(weight_kg) AS minimum_kg, MAX(weight_kg) AS maximum_kg,
       SUM(weight_kg = 0) AS zero_entries, SUM(weight_kg < 0) AS negative_entries
FROM intelligence
WHERE attribute_value IN (SELECT attribute_value FROM intelligence WHERE superhero_name = 'Abomination')
GROUP BY attribute_value, typeof(weight_kg)
